title: Grateful Dead Live at Manhattan Center on 1971-04-06
source: Unknown lineage soundboard reels > Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me @24bit/96kHz > Apogee mini DAC(monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One Audio Card > Wavelab 5.0 > FLAC by Matt Smith Edited and Mastered by Jamie Waddell on the GEMS Edit Station Weiss-Saracon for Pow-r3 Dither MetaData with Tag and Rename TLH for FLAC Level 8

ai_review.summary: Excellent SBD capture of an April ’71 show with a lazy first set but a superlative second half featuring Bertha, Greatest Story Ever Told, Sugaree, Not Fade Away reprise, Truckin’, Oh Boy and Good Lovin’.
ai_review.review: The recording is hailed as the best sound‑board (SBD) version available, delivering crystal‑clear mix and balance. Musically the concert shines in its second half—standout performances of Bertha, Greatest Story Ever Told, Sugaree, a killer Not Fade Away reprise, Truckin’, Oh Boy and Good Lovin’—though the first set is noted as rather lazy. Overall it’s a highly enjoyable April ’71 performance that rewards listeners despite an uneven opening.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and consistently praise both the soundboard quality and the musical highlights, giving a clear indication of an excellent show with outstanding recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best SBD version so far; crisp, clean mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as lazy; momentum builds dramatically in the second set, especially the latter half, creating a strong overall arc.
